title_en: Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues concerning the Application of Law in the Trial of Labor Dispute Cases (IV)

articles.content_en:
Article 2 The type of arbitral award shall be determined by the arbitral award document.
If the arbitral award document does not specify whether the award is a final award or a non-final award, and the employer refuses to accept the arbitral award and initiates a lawsuit with the Primary People's Court, the court shall handle the case according to the following circumstances:
(1) If after examination it finds that the arbitral award is a non-final award, the Primary People's Court shall accept the case;
(2) If after examination it finds that the arbitral award is a final award, the Primary People's Court shall not accept the case, but shall inform the employer that it may apply to the Intermediate People's Court in the locality where the labor dispute arbitration commission is located for revocation of the arbitral award within thirty days from the date of receipt of the ruling of non-acceptance; if the case has already been accepted, the court shall rule to dismiss the action.

Article 3 When the Intermediate People's Court hears a case filed by an employer applying for revocation of a final award, it shall form a collegiate bench and hold a hearing. After reviewing the case files, conducting investigations, and questioning the parties, if the collegiate bench finds that there are no new facts, evidence, or reasons and deems a hearing unnecessary, it may decide not to hold a hearing.
The Intermediate People's Court may organize mediation between the parties. If a mediation agreement is reached, a mediation document may be prepared. If one party fails to perform the mediation agreement within the prescribed time limit, the other party may apply to the People's Court for compulsory enforcement.

Article 4 Where parties reach a mediation agreement only on payment obligations under the auspices of a people's mediation committee, and both parties deem it necessary, they may jointly apply to the Primary People's Court in the locality where the people's mediation committee is located for judicial confirmation.

Article 6 Where parties have agreed on non-competition restrictions in the labor contract or a confidentiality agreement, but have not agreed to provide economic compensation to the worker after the rescission or termination of the labor contract, and the worker has performed the non-competition obligation and requests the employer to pay monthly economic compensation at 30% of the worker's average monthly salary for the twelve months preceding the rescission or termination of the labor contract, the People's Court shall support such request.
If the 30% of the average monthly salary as prescribed in the preceding paragraph is lower than the minimum wage standard in the place where the labor contract is performed, the compensation shall be paid in accordance with the minimum wage standard in that place.

Article 7 Where parties have agreed on non-competition restrictions and economic compensation in the labor contract or a confidentiality agreement, and when the parties rescind the labor contract, unless otherwise agreed, if the employer requests the worker to perform the non-competition obligation, or after the worker has performed the non-competition obligation requests the employer to pay economic compensation, the People's Court shall support such request.

Article 8 Where parties have agreed on non-competition restrictions and economic compensation in the labor contract or a confidentiality agreement, and after the rescission or termination of the labor contract, the employer fails to pay economic compensation for three months due to reasons attributable to the employer, and the worker requests termination of the non-competition restriction agreement, the People's Court shall support such request.

Article 9 During the non-competition period, if the employer requests to terminate the non-competition agreement, the People's Court shall support such request.
When the non-competition agreement is terminated, if the worker requests the employer to additionally pay the worker three months' economic compensation for non-competition, the People's Court shall support such request.

Article 10 Where a worker violates the non-competition agreement and pays liquidated damages to the employer, and the employer requests the worker to continue performing the non-competition obligation in accordance with the agreement, the People's Court shall support such request.

Article 11 Where a modification to the labor contract is not made in writing, but the orally modified labor contract has been actually performed for more than one month, and the content of the modified labor contract does not violate laws, administrative regulations, national policies, or public order and good customs, if a party claims that the modification of the labor contract is invalid on the ground that it was not made in writing, the People's Court shall not support such claim.

Article 12 Where an employer that has established a trade union rescinds the labor contract in compliance with the provisions of Articles 39 and 40 of the Labor Contract Law, but fails to notify the trade union in advance in accordance with Article 43 of the Labor Contract Law, and the worker requests the employer to pay compensation on the ground that the employer has illegally rescinded the labor contract, the People's Court shall support such request, unless the employer has corrected the relevant procedures before the prosecution.

Article 13 After the Labor Contract Law comes into force, if the labor contract cannot be further performed because the employer's term of operation expires and the employer ceases business, and the worker requests the employer to pay economic compensation, the People's Court shall support such request.

Article 14 Where a foreigner or a stateless person signs a labor contract with an employer within the territory of China without obtaining an employment certificate according to law, or a resident of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, the Macao Special Administrative Region, or the Taiwan Region signs a labor contract with an employer in the mainland without obtaining an employment certificate according to law, and the party requests confirmation of the existence of a labor relationship with the employer, the People's Court shall not support such request.
For a foreigner who holds a "Foreign Expert Certificate" and has obtained a "Foreign Expert Work Permit in China" and establishes an employment relationship with an employer within the territory of China, it may be determined as a labor relationship.

Article 15 Where any relevant judicial interpretation promulgated by this Court before the coming into force of this Interpretation conflicts with this Interpretation, it shall cease to apply from the date when this Interpretation comes into force.
For labor dispute cases that have not been finally adjudicated after the coming into force of this Interpretation, this Interpretation shall apply; for cases that have been finally adjudicated before the coming into force of this Interpretation, and where the parties apply for retrial or the case is decided to be retried in accordance with the trial supervision procedure, this Interpretation shall not apply.
